objs.name: document
objs.description: Central managed information object representing policies, guidelines, procedural instructions, or work instructions, subject to creation, editing, release, distribution, versioning, and archiving.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the document (e.g., policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction).

attributes.name: document_level
attributes.description: Hierarchical level in the document pyramid the document belongs to.

attributes.name: document_abbreviation
attributes.description: Type abbreviation and consecutive number identifying the document (e.g., RL_0001).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Current version number of the document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the document (e.g., editing, released, out of force, archived).

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the released document version is valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date until which the document version remains valid.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Configurable period (default 3 years) after which validity must be re-checked.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Configurable period (default 10 years) for which archived documents are retained before physical deletion.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Scope or area of validity of the document.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: References to other documents or master data maintained in document properties.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Companies or areas for which the document is valid.

attributes.name: source_format
attributes.description: Original office format of the document content (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.).

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled supplementary document linked to a main document; subject to its own versioning and released together with the main document.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Supplementary information object linked to a document that is not subject to the release cycle and can be published directly.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A proposal for changing an existing released document, managed separately without affecting the document content or version history until scheduled for implementation.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: System-generated request created 30 days before a document's validity expires, triggering a workflow to check and extend validity.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: Request to invalidate a document and archive it, triggering a workflow for out-of-force declaration.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: Request to reactivate a previously invalidated (archived) document, created by the Business Admin group.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Predefined template associated with a document type, selectable when creating new documents.

objs.name: user
objs.description: Individual person in the system who can hold roles such as author, co-author, reviewer, releaser, translator, or reader.

attributes.name: system_role
attributes.description: License-based role assigned to the user (e.g., AUTHOR, Reader).

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Named group of users used to assign collective read or change authorizations and distribution memberships.

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: System-supported process instance controlling the steps of creation, review, release, validity extension, override, reactivation, or acknowledgement.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: Digital signature provided by workflow participants to confirm completion of a workflow step.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List of user groups and persons assigned to a document for email notification or acknowledgement upon release.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: User- and role-specific view displaying documents and evaluations relevant to the logged-in user.

objs.name: process
objs.description: Business process that can be linked to documents for process-specific filing and management.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: Organizational entity that can be linked to documents via database integration.

objs.name: client
objs.description: Tenant in a multi-client system in which documents can be made visible but not changed.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A new document (information object) is created in the system by selecting a document type and optionally a template.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: The type selected for the new document.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: The content of a document is edited using the integrated editing client in the corresponding Office component.

evts.name: maintain_document_properties
evts.description: Metadata and attributes of a document are maintained or updated in the properties dialog.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: After saving, the document is automatically converted to PDF for web display.

evts.name: sign_workflow_step
evts.description: A workflow participant completes a workflow step by providing an electronic signature.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: The 3-step release process (Creator, Review, Release) is initiated by the author or a co-author.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: A reviewer checks the document content for technical and/or formal correctness.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: A releaser approves the document for distribution to readers.

evts.name: reject_document
evts.description: A reviewer or releaser rejects the document during the release workflow, canceling the workflow for subsequent participants.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: After release, the document is automatically published and made visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: A new editing version of a released document is created for revision, retaining data from the previous version.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: An author creates a change proposal for an existing released document.

evts.name: process_change_proposal
evts.description: The author of the document documents the editing of an assigned change proposal.

evts.name: create_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: The system automatically creates a validity extension request 30 days before the valid-until date expires.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: The releaser (and optionally author and reviewer) confirms the continued validity of a document, updating the valid-until date.

evts.name: create_request_for_override
evts.description: A user with write access creates a request to invalidate and archive a document.

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: The document is declared out of force, revoking all rights except for the archive group and starting the archive duration.

evts.name: archive_document
evts.description: An invalidated document and its attachments are archived by withdrawing authorizations.

evts.name: delete_archived_document
evts.description: After the archive period expires, the document is physically deleted from the system.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: The Business Admin group creates a request to reactivate an invalidated document.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: A previously invalidated document is reactivated, restoring metadata, authorizations, distribution list, and attachments into a new version.

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: A controlled attachment is added to a document, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is marked for archiving and archived upon release of the next main document version.

evts.name: add_additional_info
evts.description: An additional info object is added to a document without affecting the main document version or release cycle.

evts.name: distribute_document_by_email
evts.description: Users and user groups on the distribution list are notified by email upon release of a new document version.

evts.name: distribute_document_for_acknowledgement
evts.description: Users and user groups on the distribution list are requested to actively confirm acknowledgement upon release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A recipient confirms acknowledgement of a released document version via a workflow task.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Read or change authorizations are assigned to user groups or individual persons for a document.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: A released document is translated into another language.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: A translated document version is checked and released with workflow support.

o2o.description: A document can have one or more controlled attachments linked to it.
A document can be supplemented with additional info objects.
A change proposal belongs to and is displayed within a specific document.
A request for validity extension is linked to the document to be checked.
A request for override is created for a specific document to initiate invalidation.
A request for reactivation references the archived document to be reactivated.
Documents can reference other documents via the references attribute.
One or more document templates can be defined for each document type and selected at creation.
Documents can be linked to processes for process-specific filing.
Documents can be linked to organizational units via database integration.
Each document has a distribution list specifying user groups and persons for notification and acknowledgement.
User groups are assigned to a document's distribution list.
Individual persons can be directly assigned to a distribution list.
Users are assigned to user groups for collective authorization management.
For each document in a multi-client system, visibility per client can be specified.
